<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- iOS status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="27" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <rect x="331" y="17" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="336" y="14" width="3" height="8" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="341" y="11" width="3" height="11" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <line x1="351" y1="21" x2="355" y2="17" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="355" y1="17" x2="359" y2="21" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="353" y1="21" x2="357" y2="21" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="367" y="12" width="20" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="369" y="14" width="15" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="388" y="15" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="35,70 25,80 35,90" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="26" y1="80" x2="48" y2="80" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="68" y="88" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Forgot Password</text>
  </g>
  <line x1="20" y1="108" x2="370" y2="108" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Logo placeholder -->
  <g>
    <rect x="150" y="133" width="90" height="76" rx="8" fill="#F5C4181A" stroke="#F5C418" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="163" y="146" width="64" height="50" rx="5" fill="#F5C418" opacity="0.9"/>
    <text x="195" y="177" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">LOGO</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Main content -->
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="258" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Reset your password</text>
    <text x="195" y="290" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Enter your email and we’ll send you</text>
    <text x="195" y="311" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">a link to reset your password.</text>

    <text x="24" y="365" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Email address</text>
    <rect x="20" y="377" width="350" height="52" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C4C4C4" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="36" y="409" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">name@example.com</text>
    <text x="24" y="451" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Use the email address linked to your account.</text>

    <g>
      <rect x="20" y="482" width="350" height="48" rx="8" fill="#0000001A"/>
      <rect x="20" y="480" width="350" height="48" rx="8" fill="#F2C94C"/>
      <text x="195" y="510" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#333333">Continue</text>
    </g>

    <g>
      <rect x="20" y="544" width="350" height="48" rx="8" fill="#333333"/>
      <text x="195" y="574" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Back</text>
    </g>

    <text x="195" y="645" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">By continuing, you agree to our</text>
    <text x="195" y="669" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Terms of Use  ·  Privacy Policy</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Light navigation bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="774" width="390" height="70" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="774" x2="390" y2="774" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <!-- Home -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="36,797 47,788 58,797" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <rect x="39" y="796" width="16" height="13" rx="1.5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="47" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Home</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Search -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="139" cy="797" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="145" y1="803" x2="151" y2="809" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="139" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Search</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Wishlist -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="243" cy="794" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <circle cx="253" cy="794" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <polygon points="238,796 248,806 258,796" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="248" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Wishlist</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Profile -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="343" cy="794" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#F2C94C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <ellipse cx="343" cy="806" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#F2C94C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="343" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#F2C94C">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
